title: Roots Podcast Series - Rural Resilience in Nepal & Sierra Leone
shortDescription: Co-written, sound-engineered, and mastered multi-track evaluation podcast series launched across Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and SoundCloud exploring credit-based cooperatives in rural Nepal.
mandateChallenge: Turn written independent evaluation reports into an intimate acoustic narrative featuring field voices and development economists.
executionCraft: Executed multi-track dialogue editing, spectral noise reduction, acoustic pacing, and sound mastering in Adobe Audition with multi-platform RSS syndication.
impactMetric: Launched on Spotify, Apple Podcasts & SoundCloud
